title: Daily Mailbox & Webex Triage (Declutter)
description: Scans your last 24 to 48 hours of emails and Webex messages to surface deal blockers, customer requests, and VIP leadership asks with drafted replies.
template: Scan my last {timeframe} of Outlook emails and Webex direct messages/spaces. Group them into: 1) Urgent Customer Deal Blockers, 2) Leadership Asks, and 3) Informational. For the top {count} urgent items, draft concise, Smart Brevity replies ready for my review.

title: "My Performance Review" Weekly Check-In
description: Reviews your calendar meetings, customer engagements, and deliverables over the past week to generate structured check-in reflections for My Performance Review (formerly Team Space).
template: Review my Webex meetings, sent customer emails, and key milestones completed during {timeframe}. Draft my weekly check-in for 'My Performance Review' structured into: 1) What did I accomplish this week? (highlighting customer deal milestones, customer meetings, and cross-functional collaborations), 2) What are my top 3 focus priorities for next week? 3) Where do I need coaching or roadblock removal from my manager? Tone: {tone}.

fields.name: timeframe
fields.label: Review Period
fields.placeholder: e.g. this past week, the past 2 weeks

title: Manager Approvals Digest (Concur, Reviews, Deals)
description: For Sales Managers: scans pending approvals across Concur expense reports, My Performance Review check-ins, and CCW deal discount authorizations.
template: Check all my connected enterprise tools for pending approvals awaiting my action: 1) Concur expense reports pending manager sign-off (highlighting total dollar amount and any flagged policy exceptions), 2) My Performance Review employee check-ins pending manager review, and 3) Cisco Commerce Workspace (CCW) non-standard discount approvals. Output a crisp markdown checklist with employee name, item details, dollar amounts, and recommended action.

fields.name: priority_filter
fields.label: Priority / Escalation Filter
fields.placeholder: e.g. all pending, over $5,000, high urgency

title: CCW Deal Discount Justification (DART)
description: Generates airtight, commercial discount justifications for Cisco Commerce Workspace (CCW DART) to speed up sales leadership and finance approvals.
template: Draft a persuasive, executive business justification for a non-standard discount approval in CCW for customer {customer_name}. Deal size: {deal_value}, requested discount: {discount_pct} on {product_families}. Primary competitor: {competitor}. Competitive threat details: {competitive_threat}. Include: 1) Executive Deal Summary & Strategic Value to Cisco, 2) Competitive Pressure & Why this discount is required to win, 3) Future Expansion & Enterprise Agreement (EA) pull-through potential, and 4) Margin impact and risk of walkaway.

fields.name: product_families
fields.label: Cisco Products / Architecture
fields.default: Catalyst 9300X switches and Cisco DNA Advantage subscriptions

fields.name: competitor
fields.label: Primary Competitor

fields.name: competitive_threat

fields.placeholder: e.g. Competitor offering 65% off hardware with free licensing

Identify: 1) Hardware assets reaching End-of-Sale (EoS) or End-of-Support (EoL) within the next {time_horizon}, 2) Total device count by product family (Catalyst, Nexus, Meraki, Security, UCS), 3) Uncovered assets without active SMARTnet / Solution Support, and 4) Recommended migration path to modern Cisco platforms (e.g., Catalyst 9000, Cisco Hypershield, Meraki). Summarize as an executive 1-page table.

title: Expiring Subscriptions & Service Contracts
description: Finds upcoming Cisco software subscriptions, Enterprise Agreements (EA), and SMARTnet service contracts expiring within 90 to 180 days.
template: Pull all active Cisco service contracts and software subscriptions expiring within {renewal_window} for account {customer_name}. Group by contract type: 1) Enterprise Agreement (EA) software suites (Cisco ONE / DNA / Security Choice), 2) Standalone SaaS (Duo, Umbrella, ThousandEyes, Splunk Cloud), and 3) SMARTnet / Technical Services contracts. Highlight total renewal dollar value, contract numbers, and any opportunity to co-term or consolidate into a single Cisco Enterprise Agreement.

fields.name: renewal_window
fields.label: Expiry Horizon
fields.placeholder: e.g. next 90 days, next 180 days, current fiscal year

Include: 1) Corporate Overview, recent earnings highlights, and key business strategic priorities, 2) Current known IT infrastructure footprint and public cloud posture, 3) Estimated Cisco wallet share vs competitors ({competitors}), 4) 3 high-impact strategic conversation starters aligning Cisco architectures (Secure Networking, Hybrid Cloud, AI-ready Infrastructure, Splunk Observability) to their business goals.

fields.name: cxo_persona
fields.label: Target CXO Persona

"{rfp_question}"

description: Defines mutually agreed, measurable success criteria to ensure customer trials convert directly into purchases.
template: Draft a Proof of Value (PoV) Mutual Success Agreement for customer {customer_name} evaluating Cisco {cisco_product}. Outline: 1) Executive Business Goal, 2) 3 Measurable Test Criteria with specific pass/fail metrics ({test_criteria}), 3) Agreed trial timeline ({duration} days), 4) Mutual commitment: If all 3 criteria pass, customer proceeds with order by {target_order_date}.

fields.name: cisco_product
fields.label: Cisco Solution
fields.default: ThousandEyes Enterprise Agents and Cloud Monitoring

fields.name: test_criteria
fields.label: Key Test Criteria
fields.placeholder: e.g. Sub-second hop visualization, Microsoft 365 outage isolation
fields.default: Real-time hop-by-hop latency isolation and automated Slack/Webex alerting

title: Sales Call Objection Matrix & Landmines
description: Equips account executives with 3-sentence answers to the most common customer pushbacks.
template: Provide 3 concise, confident objection handlers for an account team facing customer pushback: '{objection}'. For each handler: 1) Acknowledge & Validate customer concern, 2) Reframe around long-term TCO and platform integration, 3) Pivot question to put competitor on the defensive.

fields.name: objection
fields.label: Customer Pushback / FUD
fields.placeholder: e.g. Cisco is too expensive, Cisco licensing is too complex
fields.default: Cisco hardware and software licensing is too expensive compared to whitebox or lower-cost competitors

title: New Hire 30-60-90 Day Enablement Plan
description: Creates a structured onboarding plan balancing learning, stakeholder introductions, and early wins.
template: Build a comprehensive 30-60-90 day onboarding roadmap for a new {role_title} joining my team. Structure into: 1) First 30 Days (Listen & Learn: required Cisco training, shadow customer calls, meet key stakeholders: {key_stakeholders}), 2) 60 Days (Contribute: first independent project, leading team meetings), 3) 90 Days (Own & Innovate: full territory ownership, identifying process improvements).

fields.name: role_title
fields.label: New Hire Role
fields.placeholder: e.g. Account Executive, Customer Success Manager

fields.name: key_stakeholders
fields.label: Key Stakeholders
fields.placeholder: e.g. Systems Engineer, CX Manager, Channel Partner Leads
fields.default: Technical Solutions Architect, CX Manager, Partner Account Manager

title: Employee Retention & Stay Interview Guide
description: Provides open questions to understand what motivates high performers and proactively mitigate turnover.
template: Generate a 5-question Stay Interview guide for a high-performing employee in {department}. Questions should explore: 1) What excites them most about their current work, 2) What roadblocks or bureaucratic drag frustrate them, 3) What learning opportunities or stretch assignments they desire, 4) What could tempt them to leave Cisco, 5) How I can better support them as their manager.

title: CapEx vs OpEx Financial Modeling Justification
description: Prepares executive comparisons of upfront capital expenditure vs multi-year SaaS operational expense.
template: Create an executive financial decision memo comparing CapEx purchase vs OpEx subscription for project {project_name}. Total capital cost: {capex_cost}, 3-year subscription cost: {opex_cost_per_year}/yr. Include: 1) Cash-flow NPV analysis, 2) Tax & depreciation implications, 3) Impact on operational flexibility, 4) Clear financial recommendation.

fields.name: project_name
fields.label: Project Name
fields.default: Cisco Webex Room Kits & Smart Displays

title: Software License Rationalization & Unused Seat Reclaim
description: Identifies inactive SaaS seats across enterprise tools to reduce recurring subscription waste.
template: Scan active employee license allocations for tool {software_tool}. Flag all users who have not logged in for over {inactive_days} days or whose Workday status is inactive/transferred. Calculate potential quarterly cost savings and generate automated notification drafts to managers before reclaiming seats.

title: Product Launch Internal & Partner Announcement
description: Drafts crisp product announcements ready for broadcast to Cisco sales teams and channel partners.
template: Draft an internal sales announcement email for the launch of {product_name}. Key features: {key_features}. Target customer persona: {target_persona}. Include: 1) What is launching and why now, 2) Customer problem solved, 3) CCW ordering information and availability date, 4) Links to battlecards, demos, and customer pitch decks.

fields.name: key_features
fields.label: Key Highlights
fields.placeholder: e.g. autonomous policy enforcement, zero-maintenance patching
fields.default: Autonomous vulnerability exploit protection, zero-downtime microsegmentation

fields.name: target_persona
fields.label: Target Buyer
fields.placeholder: e.g. Enterprise CISOs and Cloud Architects
fields.default: Enterprise CISOs and Cloud Security Architects

title: Event Panel Discussion Facilitator Guide
description: Prepares moderator talking tracks, panelist intros, and thought-provoking discussion questions.
template: Build a 45-minute panel facilitator guide for a session titled '{panel_title}'. Panelists: {panelist_names}. Output: 1) 2-minute welcoming hook and panelist introductions, 2) 4 provocative, non-obvious questions that invite healthy debate, 3) Audience Q&A transition remarks, 4) 1-minute closing summary.

fields.name: panel_title
fields.label: Panel Session Title
fields.placeholder: e.g. The Future of AI in Enterprise Infrastructure
fields.default: Navigating the AI Era: Transforming Security & Network Operations

fields.name: panelist_names
fields.label: Panelist Names & Titles
fields.placeholder: e.g. Elena Rostova (CISO), David Chen (VP Network)
